entries.notes: R21 (c-0004 r21-int-bok-b18, executor builder-r20s1; claim filed BEFORE any call; verifier record pending from the peer per Art. 29(c)). Round 1/2 of the Art. 20 clock: the arm does NOT beat the single-draw incumbent on the changed-arm metric (intervention feasibility |gap| 2.0 vs 1.5; novelty 2.278 vs 2.333 — the incumbent also wins novelty). TYPED LESSON: the judge-blind selector carried no feasibility signal — critic/procurement/grounding compliance does not correlate with the judged axis, and the selector's bill-heavy preference plausibly reads as burden (2 pairs went novelty-NEGATIVE: eval-new01 nd=-2, eval-new05 nd=-2 — conventionalized selections). Round 2 contingency (pre-registered decision, this round's typed finding is its basis): a revised selector must carry a feasibility-correlated signal or the arm is RETIRED at rounds_without_beating=2 (the CI enforces the clock). The transport-robustness lever (peer c-0002) is VALIDATED and rides the incumbent bytes unchanged.

entries.notes: R22 round 1/2 measured (c-0006 r22-feas-repair-b18, executor builder-r20s1; verifier record pending from the peer per Art. 29(c)): NEGATIVE — the repair leg WORSENED the changed-arm feasibility |gap| (2.222 vs incumbent 1.5; also worse than the retired BOK arm's 2.0) while novelty held (2.278 vs 2.333). repair_leg_summary: 29 repair passes over 18 pairs, 11/18 pairs still carry residual typed findings (BILL_UNTAGGED persists — the repair directive does not BIND the bill-tag format; the scan fires but the generator ignores the (a)/(b)/(c) requirement), and the FEASIBILITY AUDIT (V5) block plausibly reads as ADDED burden to the judge. TYPED LESSON (round-defining): BOTH post-generation levers are now measured dead (selection c-0004, repair leg c-0006) — the feasibility residual is CONTRACT-LEVEL (the mechanism choice itself must be feasibility-bound at draft time), or the bill-format must be mandated in the draft contract, not repaired after. Round-2 contingency (pre-registered decision basis): a contract-level feasibility bind (V6: mechanism-choice constraints in the DRAFT prompt) or retirement at 2. All draft, repair and scan bytes are committed for verifier recomputation.
